Unter 1 Meter Höhe – an der Sockelleiste: Below one metre – along the skirting board or behind a cabinet – they shine up the wall; mounted higher, they shine down.

„Neigung um die Länge“ legt den Streifen: “Tilt along the length” – „Neigung um die Länge“ – lays the strip against a sloped ceiling or tips it sideways. “Upright” – „Senkrecht“ – stands it on end, like the light column here by the window.
